name: clean-home-tizen
description: Clean Home for Samsung Tizen 5.0 and newer; choose your own apps.

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run check:device && npm run check:browser && npm run check:q60b && npm run check:bing && npm run check:reliability && npm run check:onboarding && npm run check:startup-input && npm run check:backgrounds && npm run check:responsive && npm run check:python && npm run check:legacy-network && npm run check:reports
scripts.check:package: node scripts/check-package.mjs && node scripts/check-reports.mjs --widget && node scripts/check-report-send.mjs --widget
scripts.check:reports: node --test tests/reports.test.cjs tests/report-send.test.cjs && node scripts/check-reports.mjs && node scripts/check-report-send.mjs
